source_applicability_limitations: Exploitability is not assessed. No exploit, runtime reachability, or full configuration validation was performed.
A limited search of apps/api/src/main found no explicit XsltView, SSE helper, or SniHandler usage. This is insufficient to classify a finding as not affected.
Preserve original scanner severity and show vendor severity separately; differences do not constitute a false-positive determination or risk acceptance.
All 105 findings have a FixedVersion field, but this does not prove a compatible, publicly available, complete remediation exists.
No prior equivalent Java scan was established, so these findings cannot be attributed to the new request timing code.
OS findings of zero are limited to the scanned package inventory and vulnerability database; they do not establish overall application security.
